scope: CPU code review and targeted recovery/proxy fixes; no GPU, simulation, image build or service lifecycle operations by this audit agent.

changes.behavior: After browser close, response error, or size cap, discard retained HTTP chunks and ignore subsequent data/end callbacks. Preserve sanitized binary frame metadata, JPEG bytes, conditional ETags and byte limits.
changes.regressions: Two tests first failed on the original handler: late data/end wrote a response after client close or oversize abort.

changes.behavior: Retain immutable IncomingMessage buffers instead of copying each; reuse one-chunk envelopes; write sanitized metadata then the original JPEG slice instead of a second complete-envelope buffer.
changes.limit: This removes two JPEG-sized copies on multi-chunk reads, but is not an end-to-end FPS or memory-leak claim.

changes.behavior: Preserve classImageToGroundHomographies in the public source allowlist so caller context validation can reject frames from another class calibration.
